page.overview:
Who is Agent Swipe?

Agent Swipe is an Agent from the Agents line seen in 2009. He has only appeared in one set, an Agents 2.0 set. The minifigure was produced with blond hair, the same mould that was used for Agent Charge's hair piece, the Agent torso and legs design and the minifigure is equipped with a "bullet-proof vest". The face design is unique to this character it shows cheek bones, brown eyebrows, and a communication device.
